prompt: Tell me about the best resume format for someone who has been out of work for 15 years.
response: If you've been out of work for 15 years, a functional resume format is best because it focuses on skills rather than employment history. You can list your skills and accomplishments without detailing your outdated work experience. This format will help you transition back to work by emphasizing your adaptability and relevant skills. It's less important to include dates or previous job titles.
